paras: Fowlea melanzosta, also commonly known as the Javan keelback water snake and the  Javanese keelback water snake, is a species of snake in the family Colubridae. The species is endemic to Indonesia.
F. melanzosta is found in Java and Bali, Indonesia.
F. melanzosta is a common species typically encountered in rice paddies, but it also occurs near lakes, rivers, streams, marshes, and in grassland.
